scheme_name: Free Distribution of Rice to Differently Abled Persons
other_conditions: Resident of the Union Territory of Puducherry for at least 5 years
Beneficiary under the "Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person" scheme
benefits_summary: Recipients receive 15 kg of rice per month or an equivalent Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents (if required)
